what_is_at_stake: which order; minted by the database on save and carried by every event from GracePeriodConfirmed on
which checkout; makes the create idempotent and is never stored on the order
whose order: the user id from the sub claim, sent in the request body
what was ordered and how many; checked against stock and decremented when paid
the money at stake: units times unit price, nothing else
whose basket: the only key the basket has, from the caller's identity
what the customer means to buy; the only content the store keeps
not kept in the basket: every read prices the lines at the catalogue's current price, so the price shown can change between visits
